attchmntText: Deepak Fertilizers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about update on ITAT appeal against the Company   Outcome of Appeals
sm_name: Deepak Fertilizers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited intimated that the Income-tax Appellate Tribunal, Mumbai, dismissed appeals filed by the Department for Assessment Years 2013-14 to 2018-19. This outcome confirms the relief allowed in the Commissioner of Income Tax Appeals order dated 8th January 2026, involving disputed taxable income of Rs. 215 Crores. Additionally, the Company's appeals for Assessment Years 2015-16 and 2016-17 were allowed in its favor for statistical purposes. The information was received via email at 01:10 p.m. on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Deepak Fertilizers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026".
sm_name: Deepak Fertilizers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The meeting commenced at 6.00 p.m. and concluded at 6.12 p.m. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 61,958 Lakhs, and net profit after tax was Rs. 2,560 Lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 2.03. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 1,13,655 Lakhs, and net profit after tax was Rs. 9,394 Lakhs. Earnings per share for the half year was Rs. 7.44. The statutory auditors, P G Bhagwat LLP, issued a limited review report stating that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the financial results.

attchmntText: Deepak Fertilizers And Petrochemicals Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of new step-down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
sm_name: Deepak Fertilizers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited
voiceSummary: Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited has incorporated Mahadhan Nutritek Solutions Limited as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary. The incorporation occurred on 26th October 2026. Mahadhan Nutritek Solutions Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mahadhan AgriTech Limited, which is itself a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. The new entity will engage in manufacturing, processing, and dealing in chemicals, fertilizers, and agrochemicals. Authorized share capital is Rs. 10.00 Crores. Paid-up share capital is Rs. 75,00,000. The Company made an initial investment of Rs. 75.00 Lakhs. Mahadhan Nutritek Solutions Limited has not yet commenced business. Consequently, turnover and size are not applicable. The name is reflected in Ministry of Corporate Affairs master data. The Certificate of Incorporation is awaited.
